1.consolidated_definition: med. Sala de partos. Sala especial de un hospital en el que la parturienta se prepara para dar a luz. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Véase labor delivery room. Ratificar y convalidar el estado de emergencia en la sala delivery room post (ldrp) o birthing rooms, en el hospital San Juan, decretado mediante la orden ejecutiva num. js-006, por el alcalde del municipio de San Juan, Hon. Jorge A. Santini Padilla (Legislatura Municipal de San Juan, 27-12-01)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Medical delivery room. A special room in a hospital where the parturient prepares to give birth. Raw anglicism, frequent. See labor delivery room. To ratify and validate the state of emergency in the post-delivery room (PDR) or birthing rooms, at San Juan Hospital, decreed by Executive Order No. JS-006, issued by Hon. Jorge A. Santini Padilla, Mayor of San Juan Municipality (San Juan Municipal Legislature, December 27, 2001).
